paper.title_en: Extreme Mass Ratio Inspirals in Light of Quasi-periodic Eruptions: Milli-Hertz Gravitational Wave Background
paper.abstract_en: Quasi-periodic eruptions (QPEs) are repeated X-ray bursts originating in galactic nuclei. Of the many proposed models, the favored model is the disk-collision model in which a stellar mass orbiter collides with a disk formed from a tidal disruption event, generating flares twice per orbit. In this model QPEs are tracers of circular extreme mass ratio inspirals (EMRIs) and can be used to infer the EMRI formation rate and estimate their contribution to the stochastic gravitational wave background (SGWB) in the Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA) band. Whether the secondary is a stellar-mass black hole or a main sequence star is still debated and leads to different results for the EMRI rate and SGWB. We obtain fiducial rates -- subject to systematic uncertainties -- of $R_{\rm SE} = 2.88\times10^{-6}$ per galaxy per year for stellar EMRIs and $R_{\rm BHE} = 6.07\times10^{-6}$ per galaxy per year for black hole EMRIs, then estimate their contribution to the SGWB. We find that only black hole EMRIs contribute to the 1 - 10 milliHertz band resolvable by LISA, and depending on the secondary mass and formation radius can contribute from just below the LISA sensitivity curve to roughly two orders of magnitude above it. Stellar EMRIs, being tidally disrupted before reaching the 1 - 10 milliHertz band, only contribute to sub-milliHertz frequencies and remain below the LISA sensitivity curve.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文提出利用准周期喷发估算极端质量比旋进事件率及其对LISA频段随机引力波背景的贡献，与脉冲星计时阵列及引力波背景主题高度相关，方法合理且有清晰的数值结果。
decision.title_zh: 极端质量比旋进在准周期喷发视角下的研究：毫赫兹引力波背景
decision.abstract_zh: 准周期喷发（QPE）是源自星系核的重复X射线爆发。在众多提出的模型中，最受青睐的是盘碰撞模型，在该模型中，一个恒星质量轨道体与由潮汐瓦解事件形成的吸积盘碰撞，每个轨道产生两次耀发。在此模型中，QPE是圆形极端质量比旋进（EMRI）的示踪物，可用于推断EMRI形成率并估算其对激光干涉空间天线（LISA）频段随机引力波背景（SGWB）的贡献。次天体是恒星级黑洞还是主序星仍存在争议，这导致EMRI率和SGWB的结果不同。我们获得了基准速率——受系统不确定性影响——恒星EMRI为$R_{\rm SE} = 2.88\times10^{-6}$每星系每年，黑洞EMRI为$R_{\rm BHE} = 6.07\times10^{-6}$每星系每年，然后估算它们对SGWB的贡献。我们发现只有黑洞EMRI对LISA可分辨的1-10毫赫兹频段有贡献，且取决于次天体质量和形成半径，其贡献可以从略低于LISA灵敏度曲线到大约高出两个数量级。恒星EMRI在到达1-10毫赫兹频段前就被潮汐瓦解，只对亚毫赫兹频率有贡献，且保持在LISA灵敏度曲线以下。
